notes: Segments were reconstructed under torch.autocast(cuda, torch.bfloat16), because this model's own gr00t/model/policy.py:189-191 wraps inference in it (--api=old). The reported bytes are the traffic of the ops as autocast runs them; autocast's OWN cast of the fp32 encoder states to torch.bfloat16 is additional traffic the shared bytes_formula does not model, and it does not arise for n1.7/n1.6, whose policy.py has no autocast.

Both kinds of DiT block are measured. DiT.forward (dit.py:310-326) sends encoder_hidden_states only on even indices when interleave_self_attention is set, so odd blocks are pure self-attention and even blocks cross-attend onto the VLM's tokens. Measuring one and calling it 'the block' would hide half the architecture.

The attention is NOT split into score / softmax / context. attn1 is a diffusers Attention running under _sdpa_context(), so those happen inside one fused kernel; separating them would mean measuring a different implementation than the model's. pi0's eager Gemma path does expose them, which is why its segment table has a softmax row and this one does not.

The feed-forward is reported whole. pi0's table splits act_fn(gate)*up from its projections per protocol §13.2; the diffusers FeedForward is a Sequential whose pieces would have to be indexed by position, which is brittle against a version change.
The timing engine is bench/host_segments.py's, unchanged, so these numbers are comparable with pi0's rather than produced by a second harness.
